title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to missing authentication in the SharePoint S-TAP RelayService,…
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection version 12.2 has a vulnerability in the SharePoint S-TAP RelayService due to missing authentication. This flaw allows an unauthenticated network attacker to inject forged audit events and access the active monitoring policy. The vulnerability is rated critical with a CVSS score of 9.1, indicating high impact on confidentiality and integrity without requiring user interaction or privileges.
